objective: Run the target-class rule C7 and read the classes R0 and R3 reach, against the cheapest walks, on the declared spaces and starts (Q1-Q4).
status: Supported in part 2026-11-10 (exploratory, pre-registered): a learner told a target class (C7) reached it in 3,173 of 3,186 runs, every one on the thin tori, within 0.4 sign changes of the cheapest walk there; the 13 misses entered the target face in the wrong sheet (post hoc, refusing that move reached all 180 grown-torus targets). Choosing a long class costs about half the torus (proved bound). Refuted: untargeted learners do not default to the short class (random 13%, sight 3 63%, on thin tori of at least 20 points); C7 missed grown-torus targets (Q4). Stress test to 46 points passed.
title: A learner given a target class
